Canary evidence intake

Demo-only evidence is source-bound and integrity checked before reconciliation. Secret material is rejected from the package.

Observed outcomes

Quarantine reasons

Canary cohort evidence

Canary review requires a reviewed multi-observation Demo cohort. One successful fill is not enough, and cohort readiness never grants order authority.

Canary policy calibration lab

Observed Demo distributions are shown as review inputs only. The lab never selects or writes canary thresholds.

Evidence freshness receipt

Canary evidence expires when source, cohort, policy, risk state, broker conditions, or reviewed age limits no longer match.

Shadow to canary reconciliation

This gate compares source-bound shadow intent with reconciled Demo execution, adapter preflight, current risk state, and reviewed portfolio evidence. A PASS permits review only and never submits an order.

Evidence checkStatus

Canary promotion firewall

A review-ready package still cannot authorize an order, expand capital, or promote itself to LIVE.

Owner canary policy review

Reviewed cohort, freshness, exposure, and loss limits are bound to the exact source before a lease can be issued. This panel is read-only and never changes a policy.

Time-limited canary lease

A canary lease is scope-bound, expires automatically, never auto-renews, and can be revoked. An active lease is still not an order.

Profitability Gates

Five gates prevent software mechanics, optimistic costs, or incomplete forward evidence from being presented as a profitable trading edge.

Readiness

Gate state

Methodology and limits

The product should become more useful as evidence improves, not more confident than the evidence permits.

Point-in-time context

Each macro claim, event, and cross-asset observation includes a known-at timestamp. The loader rejects rows that were not known at the snapshot cutoff.

Event Lock

Configured high-impact windows create a deterministic veto. A forecast does not override the lock.

Probability boundary

Direction score and reliability-binning output are research mechanics. Production probability remains unavailable until matured real predictions support calibration.

Purged backtest boundary

Train, validation, and untouched-test partitions are chronological. Horizon-aware purge removes overlapping labels and an embargo separates partitions. Untouched test never selects a strategy or threshold.

Execution cost boundary

Each required execution-cost component has an evidence state. Missing components remain unavailable and can never be silently treated as zero.

Paper simulation boundary

Sequential historical simulation validates lifecycle, MFE, MAE, and hash-chain mechanics. It is separate from the locked Paper Ledger and is not real forward-testing evidence.

Portfolio exposure boundary

Research biases can be translated into hypothetical currency and theme exposure. Production limits and verified rolling correlation inputs are still required before portfolio permission can exist.

Replay integrity

Replay stores the cutoff, evidence states, context, forecast, Risk Engine result, and a deterministic snapshot hash with future_data_used=false.

Historical regime integrity

Historical regime labels use only data available at each prediction cutoff. They are software mechanics until evaluated on independently verified market periods.

Failure analysis boundary

Failure clusters are transparent rules based on observed forecast errors. They are diagnostics, not causal explanations for why a market moved.

Research-run reproducibility

Each local run fingerprints its campaign manifest, context snapshot, registry, runtime, risk policy, source revision, decisions, and generated artifact set. A reproducible software run can still remain blocked from execution.

Next external evidence

Real read-only MT5 terminal evidence can establish broker-session observations, but independent source authentication, market-session provenance, complete execution costs, and matured forward evidence remain required before execution eligibility.
